A '''force support''' or '''support force''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[systems admiral]]. It was comprised of over one hundred ships, as well as planetside depots. Force support was responsible for munitions, consumables, spare parts and equipment for [[force technical services]], as well as [[medical ships]] and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] services. Force support had no escort vessels, and was given an escort if traveling through a combat zone.
